headline: Clinton order creates an advisory committee for the American Heritage Rivers Initiative.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets up an advisory committee connected to the American Heritage Rivers Initiative, a federal program focused on rivers and the communities along them. No summary was provided, so the committee's exact duties, membership, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Communities along rivers taking part in or seeking to join the American Heritage Rivers Initiative
who_it_affects.how: The committee would likely advise the federal government on the program, though the details are not given in the source material.
